t: Two Pistol Shots Fired Into Guard Room Of Japanese Landing Party

pages.en:

7/1
15 3 41

"B"
Misc. 66/41
Pootoo Road
14th March,
41.

1
14 - 3 - 41
Scene and vicinity,
Detective Office.

Two pistol shots fired into Guard Room of Japanese
Landing Party at No. 7 N.V.K. Mill Maeno Road at
7.40 p.m. March 14, 1941.

At 8.20 p.m. Friday March 14, 1941, C.P.C.s 2523
and 2550 reported that officers of the Japanese Landing
Party were seizing Chinese pedestrians on Maeno Road
near Gordon Road.

Enquiries were made by the Officer i/c accompanied
by D.S.I. Tilton, D.S. Mori and D.S.I. Tang Tzu Hang.

A visit to the mill premises disclosed that at
7 p.m. the Japanese Marine on sentry duty at the Mill
gate withdrew as usual when the main gates were closed,
while a side door leading to the guard room was left
open for the passage of mill employees.

At about 7.40 p.m. 1st Class Seaman Nakamura was
on duty in the guard room when two shots were fired at
the side door entrance. The two bullets passed through
a pane of glass of the guard room, making separate holes.
A further hole was made in pane of glass of an opposite
door. One of the bullets continued on and passed
completely through the window of an adjoining building
also used as a guard room.

The Japanese Landing Party immediately made a search
of Maeno Road and brought into the mill premises some
50 male Chinese pedestrians in the hope of finding
witnesses.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 15 1941 / ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER / SPECIAL BRANCH）

案发地点及周边，

1941年3月14日晚7时40分，有人向位于前野路（Maeno Road）7号的内外棉株式会社第七厂（No. 7 N.V.K. Mill）日本登陆部队警卫室开枪射击两发。

1941年3月14日（星期五）晚8时20分，中国巡捕第2523号和2550号报告称，日本登陆部队军官正在前野路靠近戈登路（Gordon Road）一带拘捕中国行人。

由负责警官会同侦探副督察长蒂尔顿（Tilton）、侦探警长森（Mori）及侦探副督察长唐子衡（Tang Tzu Hang）进行了调查。

经前往该厂址查访得知，晚7时，在厂门口执勤的日本海军陆战队哨兵按惯例在主大门关闭时撤岗，而通往警卫室的一扇侧门仍敞开，以便工厂员工通行。

约晚7时40分，一等水兵中村（Nakamura）正在警卫室执勤，此时有两发子弹射向侧门入口处。两颗子弹穿过警卫室的一块玻璃窗，留下两个独立的弹孔。对面门上的玻璃也被打出一个额外的弹孔。其中一颗子弹继续飞行，完全穿透了邻近另一座同样用作警卫室的建筑物的窗户。

日本登陆部队立即在前野路展开搜查，并将约50名中国男性行人带进厂区，希望能从中找到目击者。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1941年3月15日 / 助理总监 / 特别处）
（批：知悉）
（批：案件 15 2）

1 (Sheet 2)

One bullet and two cases of .32 cal. were stated
to have been picked up at the scene by investigating
officers of the Japanese Landing Party. Japanese
Military Police, and Japanese Consular Police also
attended the scene.

The 4th U.S.M.C. Headquarters were informed and a
patrol immediately attended at the corner of Boone and
Gordon Road.

Supt. Tabata, D.O. "B" Office attended.

All barricades in the Pootoo Road district were
closed and searches conducted until 10.15 p.m.

No arrests were made of any suspicious persons.

No description of the person or persons who fired
the shots could be obtained. There are no Chinese
dwelling houses or shops in the immediate vicinity of
the scene.

D.O. "B" informed.

据称，日本登陆部队的调查人员在现场拾获子弹一枚及.32口径弹壳两枚。日本宪兵队及日本领事警察亦赶赴现场。

美国海军陆战队第四团总部获悉后，一支巡逻队立即前往布恩路（Boone Road）与戈登路交界处。

“B”分区侦探办公室主任田畑（Tabata） superintendent 到场。

普陀路地区的所有路障均被关闭，搜查工作持续至晚10时15分。

未逮捕任何可疑人员。

未能获取开枪者的人物特征描述。案发地点附近并无中国民居或商铺。

已通知“B”分区侦探办公室主任。
